breakdown.description: The linearly varying right-edge traction is redefined with x instead of the specified y-coordinate
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to evaluate the traction profile using the x-coordinate, which contradicted the provided formula `σ_yy = -2.65e4*y Pa`. The generated specification correctly ignored this erroneous instruction and instead specified that 'The traction profile will be evaluated using the global y-coordinate', which aligns with the ground truth.
